localCompatibility.rect: numeric x,y,w,h; w,h positive; no containment requirement
localCompatibility.animations: nonempty map; sheet string; rounded frameW,frameH,cols positive; box rect; ignore frame items without numeric i and ms; remaining list nonempty, rounded i>=0 and ms>0
localCompatibility.states: ignore non-list values and empty lists; idle must remain; unknown state names accepted
localCompatibility.optionalMapOrList: wrong container types become empty; missing optional values use PetPack.parse defaults
localCompatibility.metadata: author,license,source optional locally; name defaults id
localCompatibility.sheetBounds: cols*rounded frameW <= width; (max rounded frame i // cols+1)*rounded frameH <= height
localCompatibility.scope: PetPack.parse compatibility only; local file import also requires appImportCompatibility below.

marketProfile.zip: one unambiguous root pack.json or one top-folder pack.json; reject unsafe paths, duplicate/casefold aliases, encryption and non-regular entries; never extract paths
marketProfile.sheet: flat non-dot PNG name; no slash, backslash or NUL; complete CRC and decode; reject APNG; reencode RGBA without metadata
marketProfile.normalization: deterministic ZIP containing only canonical pack.json then sorted referenced PNGs
marketProfile.publication: requires trusted maintainer approval of normalized digest; technical validation is not rights/content approval
marketProfile.androidCompatibility: emit explicit integer scale, pixelArt, rounded cell/frame/tier/timing fields; require integral canvas and frame cell == Float32(box)*scale truncated (Android); reject mismatched authored geometry, never resize it; normalized output must also pass appImportCompatibility

commonValidation.archiveNameKey: Unicode NFC followed by full casefold; ZIP UTF-8 BOM in names remains an ordinary U+FEFF character
commonValidation.json: strict UTF-8 without leading BOM, no duplicate decoded keys, isolated surrogates, nonfinite numbers or depth beyond limit
commonValidation.png: four ASCII letters per chunk type; complete CRC; legal IHDR/color/depth; ordered unique PLTE/tRNS; contiguous IDAT; exact bounded zlib EOF without trailing bytes; Adler32 and expected Adam7/noninterlaced scanline length; filters 0..4; actual pixel decode; no APNG
commonValidation.pngMetadata: iCCP/zTXt: keyword 1..79 bytes then NUL, method 0, bounded zlib; iTXt: keyword, flag 0/1, method 0, NUL-terminated language and translated keyword, text; tEXt: keyword then text. Inflated bytes of each compressed metadata payload <=pngMetadataChunkBytes per chunk; all actual text/ICC bytes <=pngMetadataTotalBytes. No per-chunk cap for uncompressed text. Exact zlib EOF/Adler32 and no trailing bytes.
commonValidation.pngDecode: only IHDR/PLTE/tRNS/IDAT/IEND go to the pixel decoder; local import retains original validated PNG bytes, market normalization emits RGBA PNG without ancillary metadata
commonValidation.memory: sheetDecodedBytes limits width*height*4 RGBA payload, not whole-process peak memory
commonValidation.metadataWhitespace: Market required metadata uses Python 3.12 str.isspace (29 code points, Unicode 15.0.0) only for the nonempty check; preserve the original whole string.

appImportCompatibility.source: pet_library.dart overlayPackProblem at c76c0db2d83573895f240307179e19802f674b1d; moved without relaxing comparisons
appImportCompatibility.scale: absent defaults 1; otherwise finite whole number in 1..4096
appImportCompatibility.frames: each item must have finite whole i in 0..1073741824 and ms in 1..1073741824; no malformed item is skipped
appImportCompatibility.geometry: frameW/H equal trunc(Float32(Float32(box.w/h) * scale)); no resizing or guessed geometry
appImportCompatibility.local: check the authored manifest after PetPack.parse, before installation
appImportCompatibility.market: check the normalized output; parser rounding may repair authored numeric representation, but cannot waive the App import gate
